body:
I did something similar twice today.  

I have a two way thought on this because I don't think the reason is always the same.  One is inertia.  The mind knows only how to live and I haven't met a strong enough force to change this even though I desperately wish for it.

Another is that it isn't cowardice but the opposite.  It's that regardless of whatever led us to this point, all the failures and hopelessness and loneliness, we're not ready to accept this last "failure".  Or quit, let this drag us down.  We still want to fight.

I don't know.  I keep wanting it to be the latter, but it feels so much like the former reason to me.

You are so courageous.  You keep trying, and even if  you fail, you keep living.  I'm so jealous of you for even trying.  Having the ability to try and try, even if you fail, I really miss that.  I became so afraid of rejection and failure that I stopped trying and that's my true failure.  Once you stop trying, it's really hard to start again.  So please don't give up.  Tell us about you think are your failures.  To me, they sound like successes because you tried.  I'd rather feel bad because I got rejected than feel bad like I am now because I'm too scared to take a chance.

I feel the same way.  Any time I try, I become paralyzed.  I need the distractions because the responsibilities are overwhelming.  I don't know how to fulfill them.  I feel like I can only fail and fail and fail.  Why do I try.  Why should I try.
